snippet.title: Toyota owner faces $13K bill after transmission fails only 600km after warranty expiration
snippet.description:
When Dona Wilkie drove her 2021 Toyota Highlander on a recent trip to Calgary this past August to drop off her son at university, she expected a smooth ride.

Instead, the B.C. resident says she experienced aggressive gear changes and a strange noise coming from her vehicle. “As I was pressing the accelerator, it would whine. At first, quite low. It was like a humming and then it got louder as the trip went on,” said Wilkie.

Wilkie says she contacted her Toyota dealership as soon as she arrived home, only to receive shocking news.

Her Highlander, which she had purchased brand new, needed a new transmission. “I was shocked,” said Wilkie.

Making matters worse, Wilkie says she was informed by the dealership that she was 600 kilometres over the 100,000 kilometres powertrain warranty and she’d have to pay for the transmission out of pocket.

Global BC’s Consumer Matters reporter Anne Drewa reports.

In gut sechs Wochen ist es so weit: Bill und Tom Kaulitz moderieren die ZDF-Kultsendung "Wetten, dass..?". Und stellen gleich selbst den ersten Rekord auf: Innerhalb der ersten zwei Stunden haben sich gleich 78.000 Menschen für das Ticket-Losverfahren registriert - so viele wie nie zuvor. Eine Registrierung ist noch bis zum 23. Oktober um 10 Uhr möglich. Die Show ist am 05. Dezember um 20:15 Uhr im ZDF zu sehen. 

Die Show der Kaulitz-Zwillinge wird die erste "Wetten, dass?"-Ausgabe seit drei Jahren. Gesendet wird live aus Halle (Saale).


-----

Hier auf ZDFheute Nachrichten erfahrt ihr, was auf der Welt passiert und was uns alle etwas angeht: Wir sorgen für Durchblick in der Nachrichtenwelt, erklären die Hintergründe und gehen auf gesellschaftliche Debatten ein. Diskutiert in Livestreams mit uns und bildet euch eure eigene Meinung mit den Fakten, die wir euch präsentieren.

Abonniert unseren Kanal, um nichts mehr zu verpassen.
Immer auf dem aktuellen Stand seid ihr auf https://www.ZDFheute.de/.

snippet.title: SpaceX Is Casting Turbine Blades to Skip a 12-18 Month Wait (Elon's Claim)
snippet.description:
Master Plan: What Elon Musk is Actually Building book: https://a.co/d/04C1qu8Z
Abundance or Collapse book: https://a.co/d/0cQgFdGH

On SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings call, Elon Musk said turbine suppliers tell SpaceX the blades and vanes for gas turbines arrive 12 to 18 months after the rest of the turbine (his claim, relaying the suppliers). Those parts sit right behind the flame: the gas can reach about 1,650 °C in the best power turbines, while the nickel alloys they're cast from melt around 1,300 °C, and at 3,600 rpm every kilogram of metal one meter from the shaft is pulled outward with about 14,500 g (our physics estimate). So they have to be cast with extreme precision.

Elon says SpaceX's rocket-engine casting team is the most advanced on Earth (his claim) and is now casting blades and vanes for the turbines that power its AI data centers. His claim: that brings power online 12 to 18 months faster than anyone else.

Labels: 12-18 months and "most advanced" are Elon's claims, not demonstrated figures. Temperatures are published industry figures (Mitsubishi Power 1,650 °C class; superalloy melting range). g-force is a simple physics estimate (3,600 rpm, 1 m radius), not a SpaceX figure.

- Gas turbine factory footage: CNBC / YouTube, "How The AI Boom Is Causing A Surge In Demand For Gas Turbines" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gk8ziQCWK1w)

snippet.title: Politics Chat, October 20, 2026
snippet.description:
Topics covered in today’s Politics Chat: Socialism is a system in which the government owns the means of production. After the Civil War, opponents of Black voting used the term socialism to attack Black political participation. Two days before congressionally mandated sanctions on Russia were set to take effect, Trump said he would waive them. Russia has proposed a trilateral meeting with Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping to decide the fate of Ukraine. Ukrainian forces lost control of their drones when Starlink slowed during one of the worst bombardments of the war. The Wall Street Journal reported that Elon Musk ordered the slowdown. Europe and Canada are working to build their own satellite systems. Republicans in Congress say they are frustrated with Trump’s actions, but they have not moved to stop him. Trump announced $8 billion for farmers, but payment rates will not be announced until after the election.
